instruction.text: Select the correct denotation of the following bolded word.

hint.text: A word’s denotation is its official dictionary definition.

atoms.a: Unfortunately, some endangered animals continue to fall victim to illegal poaching activities. Law enforcement regularly confiscates animal parts at airports.
b: ++ to seize by some official authority
to collect in a secretive way

feedback.finish: Although it’s positive that the authorities are able to track down illegal poaching activities, the word confiscate has a negative connotation since it implies a forceful taking of something.

atoms.a: Does confiscate have a positive, neutral or negative connotation?
